text:
Maya: Heads-up — Orca (enterprise prospect) submitted an RFP asking for: private VPC deployment, per-route SLOs, audit logs, and feature parity with CompetitorX. They want a Q2 launch (roughly 10-week timeline). Need product + eng + solutions view: do we push for full parity, ship a differentiator-first path, or do a hybrid parity MVP? Goal: decision in 48h. @Sophia @Jordan @Liam

Sophia: Deal size looks like ~$1.2M ARR if we can hit their compliance + SLA asks. They said timeline is firm for procurement. Sales can trade on price for features, but we should quantify engineering concessions.

Jordan: Quick clarifying q: when they say "private VPC", do they mean private control plane + customer-managed networking, or just VPC peering to our control plane? That changes infra work massively.

Liam: Orca explicitly called out "customer-managed control plane" + HSM/KMS integration in the RFP — they're in regulated finance. They also want tenant-level routing overrides and per-tenant audit trails.

Maya: Good — assume full private control plane + KMS.

Jordan: Engineering quick take: three paths with rough risk profile:
- Parity shim (fast): implement per-route SLOs and audit logs by reusing Dedicated primitives + a config layer. Medium risk, but we lose some long-term cost advantage.
- Differentiator-first: build a new tenant-routing abstraction with smarter fallbacks and dynamic quantization recommendations. Higher upfront risk and >12 week timeline.
- Hybrid: parity MVP (minimal logs + per-route SLOs) + parallel roadmap for routing/diff. Moderate cost, deployable in ~10w if spike goes well.

Jordan: Key technical unknowns we need a spike on: cross-tenant KV cache behavior, private control plane ops model, and per-route SLO enforcement in the runtime. Recommend 2-week spike (2 engs + 1 infra).

Sophia: Sales asks: if we do hybrid and promise an upgrade path to full differentiator in 6 months, will that be credible? Orca will want contract-level SLA for the MVP period.

Liam: For MVP acceptance criteria I suggest:
- Private control plane deployable to customer's VPC (helm + terraform templates)
- Per-route SLO config + enforcement with observed p95/p99 metrics
- Audit log stream to customer Kinesis/S3 with encryption at rest via their KMS
- Canary rollout and rollback hooks

Maya: Let's capture that as the launch checklist. Also need explicit success metrics for Sales to sign off: "no regression in p95 latency > 20% vs baseline" and "error rate < 0.2% under expected load".

Jordan: Example rollout config we could use for acceptance:
```
rollout:
  phase1: internal 5% traffic (smoke)
  phase2: 25% beta customers
  metrics:
    p95_latency_ms: <200
    error_rate_pct: <0.2
```

Liam: Ops note — audit logs + KMS integration will add ~2-3 days of validation per customer for compliance. Add that to timeline and SOW.

Sophia: Sales willingness: we can offer a 6-month discounted rate if they commit to an annual contract. Will need legal to vet SLA language.

deploy-bot: Created spike ticket INF-7423 and CI pipeline stub: https://redwood.internal/tickets/INF-7423

Maya: Decision proposal: run Jordan's 2-week spike to de-risk the hybrid path. If spike shows no major blockers, commit to hybrid MVP (parity shim + basic audit + SLOs) for Orca with documented upgrade path. Sales to draft term sheet with discounted introductory pricing and a conditional SLA tied to spike results. Owners: Jordan (eng spike), Liam (solutions lead for compliance), Sophia (deal owner), Maya (product). Decision deadline: +48h from this thread.

Jordan: I'll schedule the spike and post daily standups in #eng-runtime. I estimate 40-60 engineering hours for the spike.

Liam: I'll prep a compliance checklist and a minimal terraform example for the private control plane that we can reuse across pilots.

Sophia: I'll start drafting the term sheet and loop in legal. If we need to accelerate procurement I'll coordinate Orca's timelines.

Maya: Thanks — please drop quick updates here. If anyone thinks full parity is required regardless, raise it now. Otherwise I'll move forward with spike creation and owner assignments. :thumbsup:
